author: bardic-inspiration
name: Gravebane Warhammer
summary: A warhammer that shatters the undead and drinks their strength.
description: The haft is carved with names, and every name is scratched out. It rings like a bell when it is near a crypt.

stats.effect: You have a +3 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. When you hit an Undead with it, the target takes an extra 2d6 Radiant damage, and you gain 2d6 Temporary Hit Points.
